name: price-threshold-alert
description: Watch prices (crypto or currencies via Coinbase's free API) and alert once when a rule like 'BTC-USD > 100000' starts being true, not on every check.

rules.description: Comma-separated rules: PAIR OPERATOR NUMBER, operators > < >= <=. Pairs use Coinbase names like BTC-USD, ETH-EUR, SOL-USD.

state_key.description: Where the currently triggered rules are remembered

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for alerts (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'const rules = []; const errors = []; for (const raw of process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_RULES.split(",").map(r => r.trim()).filter(Boolean)) { const m = raw.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z]+)\s*(>=|<=|>|<)\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)$/); if (!m) { errors.push(raw); continue } rules.push({ rule: m[1].toUpperCase() + " " + m[2] + " " + m[3], pair: m[1].toUpperCase(), op: m[2], limit: Number(m[3]) }) } if (!rules.length) throw new Error("No valid rules. Use e.g. BTC-USD > 100000"); const pairs = [...new Set(rules.map(r => r.pair))].map(pair => ({ pair })); console.log(JSON.stringify({ rules, errors, pairs }))'

node -e 'const pair = process.env.PAIR; fetch("https://api.coinbase.com/v2/prices/" + pair + "/spot", { headers: { "User-Agent": "openclaw-cookbook" }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) }).then(async r => { const b = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); return r.ok && b.data ? { pair, price: Number(b.data.amount), currency: b.data.currency } : { pair, error: "HTTP " + r.status } }, e => ({ pair, error: String(e.name) })).then(x => console.log(JSON.stringify(x)))'

node -e 'const r = JSON.parse(process.env.RULES); const prices = {}; JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")).forEach(x => { prices[x.spot.pair] = x.spot }); const test = { ">": (a, b) => a > b, "<": (a, b) => a < b, ">=": (a, b) => a >= b, "<=": (a, b) => a <= b }; const results = r.rules.map(rule => { const p = prices[rule.pair]; if (!p || p.error) return Object.assign({}, rule, { error: (p && p.error) || "no price" }); return Object.assign({}, rule, { price: p.price, currency: p.currency, triggered: test[rule.op](p.price, rule.limit) }) }); const triggered = results.filter(x => x.triggered).map(x => x.rule).sort(); console.log(JSON.stringify({ results, invalid: r.errors, snapshot: { triggered } }))'

node -e 'const e = JSON.parse(process.env.EVAL); const raw = JSON.parse(process.env.DIFF); const d = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw; const before = (d.before && d.before.triggered) || []; const after = (d.after && d.after.triggered) || []; const fmt = n => n.toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); const byRule = Object.fromEntries(e.results.map(x => [x.rule, x])); const lines = []; after.filter(x => !before.includes(x)).forEach(rule => { const x = byRule[rule]; lines.push("🔔 " + x.pair + " is " + fmt(x.price) + " " + x.currency + ", rule “" + rule + "” is now true") }); const fired = lines.length; before.filter(x => !after.includes(x)).forEach(rule => lines.push("↩️ “" + rule + "” is no longer true")); const status = e.results.map(x => (x.error ? "⚠️ " : x.triggered ? "✅ " : "▫️ ") + x.rule + (x.error ? " (" + x.error + ")" : " (now " + fmt(x.price) + ")")); e.invalid.forEach(x => status.push("⚠️ Could not understand rule: " + x)); console.log(JSON.stringify({ alert: fired > 0, message: (lines.length ? lines.join("
") + "

" : "") + status.join("
"), results: e.results }))'
if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
